description: Views served by the Local Network directory, the HappyView AppView that indexes published projects, their managers' sets and shows, and follows.

projectView.description: A published project as the directory indexed it.

distanceM.description: Meters from the searched location, when the search had one and the project has coordinates.

setView.description: A computer.localnetwork.dj.set by one of a project's managers, as the directory keeps it: what it was and where, without its tracks.

date.description: The day it was played, as YYYY-MM-DD.

showView.description: A show as the directory keeps it, with the project it's for.

distanceM.description: Meters from the searched location, when the search had one and the show has coordinates.

match.description: How well a project fits a show.

inRange.description: False when the project is farther than the search radius and doesn't travel that far.

matchBreakdown.description: Each factor's fit before weighting. Weights: genre 40, distance 25, budget 15, capacity 8, setType 7, format 5.

matchNote.description: One reason a project fits a show, or one concern. Clients turn the code into text.

genres.description: For plays: the project's closely matching genres.

formats.description: For formats: the formats both sides share.

supportedArtist.description: An artist whose tracks DJs played. An artist is their MusicBrainz ID, else their name in any case; a name some sets give one MBID counts as that MBID's. A DJ is an act: a project whose managers are all counted as one, and only while it's active.

name.description: The name sets credit them as most.

mbid.description: Their MusicBrainz artist ID, as a bare lowercase UUID.

supports.description: Each DJ's distinct tracks of theirs, at most 5 per DJ, summed.

supportedTrack.description: A track DJs played, as its latest play names it. A track is its recording's MusicBrainz ID, else its ISRC, else its credit and title in any case; a track without an ID counts as the one other plays give it, when only one fits.

id.description: Opaque: tells tracks apart within one answer and between answers. Clients shouldn't read meaning into it.

artist.description: The artist credit, as one line.

artists.description: The artists it credits, one by one, or its whole credit as one.

recordingMbId.description: Its MusicBrainz recording ID, as a bare lowercase UUID.

mbid.description: Their MusicBrainz artist ID, as a bare lowercase UUID.

trackPlays.description: A track and every time it was played.

play.description: One time a DJ played a track.

startSeconds.description: When it starts in the set, when the set knows.

djView.description: A DJ and the active projects they manage.
